liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Supplication** (2 reviews): The jam between Estimated Prophet and Uncle John's Band is a rare Supplication jam without vocals, not Playin'; Bobby played a Supplication jam, the first since 4/13/86 according to the reviewer [12][18]
- **Franklins Tower** (1 review): Franklin's Tower runs over 17 minutes [20]
- **It Takes A Lot To Laugh, It Takes A Train To Cry** (1 review): Jerry's Train To Cry was reportedly only the third of seven in that period [18]

## Setlist highlights

- **It Takes Alot to Laugh (It Takes a Train to Cry)**: back after 1273 archived shows (6588 days); rare: 4 archived performances [24]

## The recordings

- **gd91-06-24.sbd.jeff_m.2533.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 23 songs; 192 min; rated 4/5 by 18 [1]. Said about its sound: Set I tracks had bits of silence at their starts; uploader fixed this and removed a buzzing sound before Around and Around; Soundboard is oversaturated in loud spots like Franklin's, Dew and Around, as if DAT levels were too hot; Source of the Slipknot>Franklin's filler is unknown; reviewer thinks it sounds early 80s [14][16]
- **gd1991-06-24.147391.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 167 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [3]
- **gd1991-06-24.sbd.jeffm.tetzeli.fix-2533.35251.reflac.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 166 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [4]. Said about its sound: Zoomed in, loud passages show clipped peaks, likely from the DAT deck's A/D conversion during taping [4]
- **gd1991-06-24.146590.sbd.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 19 songs; 167 min [5]
- **gd91-06-24.mahoney-akg.unknown.21648.sbeok.shnf**: source not stated; 19 songs; 165 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [10]

## Around the show

- Reviewer says Jerry, back turned, pulled the Supplication jam away from Bob in an on-stage dispute, supposedly over Dark Star teases [13]
- Taper sat about 17th row, left of center; taping security was strict at the front and tapers were caught [15]
- Tour featured both Bruce and Vince on keyboards [18]
- Day was hot and sticky; band seemed to work at cross-purposes at times, giving interesting interplay but many near-misses [19]
- Leaving, a man on a Jersey barrier shouted to the crowd about what you do with your peanut butter [19]
- Supplication jam was played only a few times after Bobby dropped the Lazy Lightning>Supplication pairing in the early 80s [12]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd91-06-24.sbd.jeff_m.2533.sbeok.shnf**: source: DSBD> DAT> CDR [1]. Also: Soundboard to DAT to CDR, then extracted with EAC and converted to SHN by Jeff M [1]
- **gd1991-06-24.147391.sbd.cm.miller.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [3]. Also: Two sets of masters were combined to make the show complete; this set is 16-bit at 44.1 [3]
- **gd1991-06-24.sbd.jeffm.tetzeli.fix-2533.35251.reflac.flac16**: transferred by Bill Tetzeli; source: Fix of shnid 2533 [4]. Also: Uploader removed overlap between CDs 2 and 3, retracked the show, and removed gaps between Set I tracks [4]
- **gd1991-06-24.146590.sbd.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson; transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD > Cassette Master (TDK SA-X100) [5]. Also: Transfers and mastering by Charlie Miller, who used two sets of masters to complete the show [5]
- **gd91-06-24.mahoney-akg.unknown.21648.sbeok.shnf**: source: FOB AKG 460 cardioid > DAT > CDDAT > CD: Panasonic sv3700 > Cool Edit Pro > CD Wave > mkw [10]. Also: Taped with AKG C460b and CK61 mics, ORTF, handheld, through Mike Grace's preamp into a Casio DA7; CC Rider through Big River patched from Ed Boardman's lawn recording, made with Schoeps hypercardioid mics [15]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Sandstone Amphitheatre - June 24, 1991](https://www.dead.net/show/june-24-1991) [25]
